signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: I'm pleased to share the top-line results from our strong second quarter.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: We said 2026 would be a year of accelerated growth and impact for Johnson & Johnson, and with our Q2 beat on the top and bottom line and raised guidance, we are delivering.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: Across oncology, immunology, neuroscience, and cardiovascular, the strength of our business is built on our unique combination of scientific expertise, scale, and disciplined execution.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: We have the strongest portfolio and pipeline in our 140-year history, with 28 products and platforms that each deliver more than $1 billion in annual sales.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: In Q2, we reported operational sales growth of 5.6%.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: Excluding STELARA, we grew double digits in the quarter.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: With sales in the quarter of more than $25 billion, we are on track to meet our 2026 target of more than $100 billion in annual revenue for the first time in our company's 140-year history.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: We are pleased with the progress of our new launches, including ICOTYDE, INLEXZO, and RYBREVANT, instilling confidence that momentum will accelerate into 2027 and beyond, with line of sight to double-digit growth by the end of the decade.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: ICOTYDE, in particular, has significant early launch momentum, with uptake accelerating and performance outpacing competitors at comparable points in their launches.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: Since launch, more than 10,000 patients have initiated therapy on ICOTYDE, underscoring the unmet need for patients seeking first-line systemic treatment with a unique combination of efficacy, safety, and the simplicity of a once-daily pill.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: In Innovative Medicine, we delivered operational sales growth of 6.8% in the quarter, with eight brands growing double digits.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: In oncology, our commitment to transform patient outcomes has never been stronger.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: We are on track to be the number one oncology company by 2030, with sales projected to exceed $50 billion.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: Once again, DARZALEX delivered sales of more than $4 billion, growing close to 18%.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: CARVYKTI, TECVAYLI, and TALVEY continue to deliver high double-digit growth.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: While we are not yet reporting quarterly sales for INLEXZO in bladder cancer, we are encouraged by the early momentum.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: During the second quarter, nearly one in three eligible patients started on an INLEXZO regimen, and new patient insertions grew approximately 75% versus the prior quarter.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: Building on our recent acquisition of Ambrx, we also announced plans to acquire Firefly Bio, adding another antibody platform that strengthens our leadership in next-generation oncology innovation.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: In immunology, we have built one of the deepest and most differentiated portfolios in the industry.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: TREMFYA remains the fastest-growing advanced therapy in both Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, delivering exceptional overall sales growth of 71% in the quarter.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: We continue to see strong upscale of IMAAVY in generalized myasthenia gravis and recently received FDA priority review status in warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: With FDA approval for the prevention of relapse in schizophrenia, we anticipate continued momentum.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: Now let's turn to MedTech, where we delivered Q2 operational sales growth of 3.6%.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: VARIPULSE, our pulsed field ablation platform for atrial fibrillation, continues to build momentum with more than 85,000 AFib patients now treated worldwide.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: We also received FDA authorization for our dual-energy THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF platform, which integrates pulsed field and radiofrequency energy in a single system to give physicians greater flexibility in tailoring ablation treatments for patients.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: In circulatory restoration, the Q2 global launch of Shockwave C2 Aero expanded our ability to treat more complex coronary disease and broadens the reach of our intravascular lithotripsy platform.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: In heart recovery, while Abiomed growth slowed in Q2 as a result of increased physician selectivity weighing on procedural volumes, we are working to strengthen confidence in our extensive clinical evidence and real-world experience.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: In surgery, we are unlocking a new era powered by robotics and digital innovation.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: We are progressing towards potential FDA authorization of OTTAVA, the world's first table-integrated robotic surgical system.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: This is one of the most significant MedTech innovations we will bring to market this decade.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: OTTAVA's unique architecture, automated features, and next-generation robotic instruments help address surgeons' unmet needs, while integration with our Polyphonic open digital ecosystem provides data-driven insights and analytics to better support surgical teams.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: In Q2, we announced the expanded U.S. availability of TECNIS PureSee as we accelerate the rollout of this extended depth of focus intraocular lens.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: Our ACUVUE portfolio delivered strong quarterly growth across all regions.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: As a part of our commitment, we recently announced an investment of more than $1 billion to scale our U.S.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: Vision manufacturing, packaging, and distribution capabilities as we expand capacity to meet growing demand for these products.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: Our progress in Q2 reflects what makes Johnson & Johnson unique, a company innovating across the full spectrum of healthcare, delivering strong performance today while building a pipeline that will transform care for patients tomorrow.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: As we look ahead, our confidence is rooted in the breadth of our innovation, from transformational medicines to next-generation medical technologies.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: That combination of science, scale, and disciplined execution is what uniquely positions Johnson & Johnson to lead the next wave of healthcare innovation.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: Your experience across all parts of Johnson & Johnson's business will be a real asset to our company as well as the investment community.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: As Joaquin highlighted earlier, we delivered a solid quarter, supported by the depth of our in-market portfolio and strong execution across our new product launches, with particularly good growth in Innovative Medicine.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: However, we remain confident in our long-term projections for the MedTech business.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: Even with a notable headwind, we still delivered performance that exceeded your expectations and enabled us to confidently raise our full year 2026 financial outlook.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: We have a broad, durable portfolio that has 28 platforms, each generating more than $1 billion in annual revenue that we are intent on adding to in the coming years.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: It is that foundation that gives us a clear line of sight to double-digit growth by the end of the decade.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: As expected, we had significant improvement in the second quarter with the year to date totaling approximately $8.7 billion and are on track for our full year free cash flow outlook approaching $21 billion.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: Our capital allocation priorities remain unchanged.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: We continue to prioritize investments with a focus on supporting our commercial launches and advancing future innovation.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: As stated previously, acquisitions are an enabler of growth, but they are not a requirement to deliver on our near and long-term objectives.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: Our financial strength allows us to continue investing in R&D while pursuing opportunities where our scientific and commercial capabilities can accelerate innovation and create differentiated value.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: A good example of that is the recently announced agreement to acquire Firefly Bio.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: The planned acquisition, expected to close in the third quarter of 2026, will add a proprietary platform designed to target KRAS-driven solid tumors, which are typically more difficult to treat and further diversifies our oncology pipeline.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: We also remain committed to returning capital directly to shareholders, primarily through our dividend.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: As always, our outlook reflects what we know today regarding foreign exchange rates, tariffs, the broader macroeconomic environment, and other external factors.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: Driven by second quarter performance and uptake of new product launches, we are increasing operational sales growth by $400 million, now expecting operational sales growth for the full year to be in the range of 6.5%-7.1%, with a midpoint of $100.6 billion.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: As a result, we now expect reported sales growth of 7.0%-7.6%, with a midpoint of $101.1 billion or 7.3%.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: As we look at the remainder of the year, based on year-to-date performance and updated guidance, we anticipate operational sales growth to improve in the second half of the year.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: Turning to other notable items on the P&L. At the beginning of the year, we guided to more than a 50 basis point improvement in the adjusted pre-tax operating margin.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: We now expect approximately a 75 basis point improvement, supported by continuing operating efficiencies and anticipated reduction and recoupment of certain tariff-related costs based on the latest rulings.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: This pre-tax operating margin improvement also considers the expected costs from the 53rd week of operations and the previously announced agreement with the U.S. government to improve access to medicines and lower costs to U.S. patients.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: We are pleased to increase our adjusted operational earnings per share range to $11.50-$11.65, which equates to an increase of $0.18 at the midpoint.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: This represents a year-on-year adjusted operational EPS growth of 7.3%.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: The updated earnings per share guidance range includes a $0.05 reduction of favorable currency when compared to prior guidance.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: Our current outlook does not include the impact of any pending acquisitions such as Firefly Bio.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: We anticipate FDA regulatory approval for IMAAVY as the first-ever treatment for patients with warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia, a rare and serious autoantibody disease.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: We also have important data readouts across our Innovative Medicine pipeline, including TECVAYLI in combination with TALVEY for patients with relapsed refractory multiple myeloma who have received one to four prior lines of therapy; pasritamig, a first-in-class bispecific antibody in patients with advanced prostate cancer who have progressed after multiple lines of therapy; and J&J 6143, an investigational first-in-class, once-daily oral therapy for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: This will be the first clinical readout from an ongoing study from our recent Ambrx acquisition.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: In cardiovascular, we expect launches for the Dual Energy THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF platform, as well as the Shockwave C2 Aero and AeroFly IVL catheters.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: In electrophysiology, we expect continued adoption of CARTOSOUND SONATA cardio mapping in the U.S. and VARIPULSE Pro in EMEA, with anticipated approval of VARIPULSE Pro in the U.S. later this year.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: In surgery, we anticipate FDA approval for the OTTAVA robotic surgical system and the EMEA launch of ETHICON 4000.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: In vision, we continue to expand availability of the TECNIS PureSee intraocular lens for cataracts and presbyopia while driving adoption of ACUVUE OASYS MAX lenses.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: We continue to evaluate all separation options that create shareholder value and set the DePuy Synthes business up for success long term.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: We are pleased with the progress made, are on track for a mid-2027 separation, and look forward to sharing updates later this year.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: To wrap up before we take your questions, our first half performance illustrates the strength and resilience of our portfolio, the momentum we are building behind our new products, and the steady progress we are making across our pipeline.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: Strategic focus, scale, and financial flexibility to invest in opportunities we believe will create the greatest value for patients should translate into meaningful value for shareholders.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: We look forward to sharing more on strategy, growth catalysts, and a longer-term outlook at our enterprise business review on December 8th.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: Your dedication and disciplined execution are what make our performance possible, and you continue to deliver meaningful innovation to more patients, improve outcomes, and raise the standard of care.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: With that, we are pleased to take your questions.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: As you know, we always had a little bit better revenue growth projected in the second half of the year, irrespective of the extra week of sales that will occur in the fourth quarter.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: I think really maybe to the heart of your question is, we do expect MedTech to grow better in the second half than the first half as well.

signals.speaker: Joe Wolk
signals.sentence: Not declines, but more modest growth until our PROTECT IV data comes out, which I'm sure Tim will have an answer to in a future question to expand upon.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: I really want to start with a big thank you to all of our Innovative Medicine colleagues around the world for an outstanding quarter of delivering for patients.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: It's also worth noting, STELARA was only 4% of our Innovative Medicine business in the second quarter.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: If you exclude that, the 96% of our business actually grew over 14%.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: This is really based on strong growth across our main key brands as well as our must-win launches.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: Glad to have the opportunity to talk about ICOTYDE because we are really thrilled with the launch and how it's progressing.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: I think as we noted last time, we feel really good about the differentiated label that we got.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: When we talk about the U.S. launch and get into some of the details that you asked, it's really off to a strong start.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: As a reminder, we were ready day one, and in fact, the first patient prescribed received ICOTYDE on that launch day, and early physician and patient enthusiasm has been really great.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: That tells us that there's really good confidence in the product, in both the efficacy and safety profile, as well as the simplicity of the simple once-daily pill.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: In total, we think the launch is going very well.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: TREMFYA in psoriatic disease, psoriasis, and PsA, that growth and market share gains have actually continued well above the market and it is notable in the second quarter that we got approval for inhibition of structural damage for TREMFYA in psoriasis and PsA.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: Additionally, we are investing to win on ICOTYDE.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: This is one of our must-win launches.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: Procedure volumes continue to be stable, and we're not seeing evidence of a broad-based slowdown in demand.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: To be clear, Larry, three of our four businesses - surgery, vision, and orthopedics - all accelerated in the quarter and performed above expectations.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: Surgery growth was driven by continued strong performance in wound closure and almost double-digit growth in biosurgery.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: Vision, you would've noticed, delivered meaningful acceleration in contact lenses and continued momentum in IOLs.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: In orthopedics, as you heard already from Joe, we continue to see that business go from strength to strength, reflecting stronger execution and the impact of multiple new products.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: In EP, as you already heard, we continue to see strong underlying demand.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: Demand remains consistent with what we would expect given the fundamentals of these markets, which continue to be driven by themes such as aging populations, increasing disease prevalence, and ongoing innovation that is expanding our access to more patients.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: We are acutely aware of the recent data that has been provided by a number of large U.S. hospital operators, highlighting pressure on certain procedure volumes, particularly in more elective areas of care.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: While we're monitoring these trends very closely, they are not reflected in what we're seeing across our portfolio today.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: While we expect that the expiration of the Affordable Care Act subsidies may create some affordability pressures for a small cohort of patients, we do not expect this to translate into a material impact on demand for MedTech and procedures.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: As already mentioned, we do expect acceleration of our performance in the second half, driven by continued performance of our businesses in Vision, in Orthopedics, and in Surgery, and certainly improvement on the back of our efforts to drive greater performance within Cardiovascular.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: We had a great quarter for CARVYKTI, with sales of $260 million, up 56% versus the prior year.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: That was driven by significant launch uptake and share gains across the earlier lines of therapy based on the approval that we got in the U.S. for CARVYKTI, and also continued expansion in the community setting.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: We are real excited about the approval of the combination regimen there.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: This is really resonating with physicians.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: In terms of U.S. uptake, we are seeing really strong early U.S. demand following the rapid approval that we had.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: That is in terms of patients that were initiated, and this is really due to new account adoption and increasing depth of prescribing.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: Certainly we are excited and very much committed to being a major player in the area of surgical robotics.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: We will provide much more detail around our exciting launch plans once approvals have been secured.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: That said, we are committed to the launch of two, assuming approvals come our way, which we're very confident about.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: We are committed to two large robotic launches this year, both the launch of OTTAVA, which we believe is truly differentiated against the existing incumbent, and of course, the launch of MONARCH for Urology, which will be a first-of-kind opportunity in that particular area.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: We will provide more information about those two launches next week.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: Frankly, just seeing the looks on their faces, the feedback we received gives me even more confidence that we have a device that will absolutely compete against the current incumbent.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: We see our robotics platform, both OTTAVA and MONARCH, being a meaningful contributor to MedTech growth by the end of the decade.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: This really helps us have great confidence this is an extraordinary opportunity for us with INLEXZO and then ultimately with our targeted therapy system as well.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: The launch of INLEXZO is going really well in the U.S.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: In the U.S., INLEXZO is outperforming all of the recent competitive launches.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: In terms of new patients and new patient insertions, those grew 75% quarter-over-quarter, and this was post the permanent J-code, giving a lot of confidence to providers in terms of that reimbursement.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: While we don't report sales on this yet, please know that we confidently beat consensus for the quarter, and we more than doubled sales in the second quarter versus the first quarter.

signals.speaker: John C. Reed
signals.sentence: Really a lot of excitement around it.

signals.speaker: John C. Reed
signals.sentence: Really excited about where the portfolio's going in the near term.

signals.speaker: John C. Reed
signals.sentence: Very excited for that million patients a year that are diagnosed with non-muscle invasive bladder cancer.

signals.speaker: John C. Reed
signals.sentence: We remain confident that for the atrial fibrillation indication, which is the largest of those opportunities, that we have the right dose and schedule based on the careful work done in phase II, based on the biomarker we're following, the therapeutic pharmacodynamic profile, that gives us confidence that we've achieved a healthy level of anticoagulation.

signals.speaker: John C. Reed
signals.sentence: Our data monitoring committee continues to look at the data.

signals.speaker: John C. Reed
signals.sentence: We're cautiously optimistic but are waiting for the endpoints, the events to occur so that we can read out the full study results.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: Alex, we're really excited about the milvexian opportunity.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: We're really excited to see the results of the study when they come.

signals.speaker: John C. Reed
signals.sentence: We're really excited about the possibility to offer this, both the efficacy along with the safety profile that milvexian promises.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: That's exactly why we remain committed to really investing in robust clinical research, including the study you just referenced, which is PROTECT IV, which is a highly powered study, almost 1,300 patients focused specifically on high-risk PCI, which we expect to read out in 2027.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: We remain very confident in the long-term potential for Impella, supported by the significant runway for growth, no current commercialized competitors, which is a key point, opportunities for further geographic expansion, and the large and growing global burden of heart disease.

signals.speaker: Tim Schmid
signals.sentence: To your question around recovery, as already mentioned by Joe, we do expect this to take some time, but we absolutely expect that our performance in the back half will be stronger than the first, and we see gradual improvements in performance back to double-digit growth over the coming quarters.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: That momentum is carried into 2027, and we continue to see double-digit growth by the end of the decade.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: I'm thrilled to have the opportunity to talk about TREMFYA.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: TREMFYA's sales for the quarter were $2 billion, our first $2 billion quarter and over 70% growth which we're really proud of.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: I mentioned before that we continue to see growth and share gains in psoriatic disease.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: That includes the other competitive IL-23s.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: Physicians are really seeing the profile as differentiated for TREMFYA versus the other competitive set.

signals.speaker: Jennifer Taubert
signals.sentence: I'll say that is even further underscored by the new data that we just released, our FUSION data that was presented at DDW, which is the first positive study in over 20 years in adults with active perianal fistulizing Crohn's.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: Johnson & Johnson today is a medical innovation powerhouse, uniquely positioned to translate breakthrough science into consistent long-term global growth.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: When I look at our top-line growth, the momentum that we are going to carry into the second half of the year into 2027, our ambition to have double-digit growth by the end of the decade, the operating leverage that that sustained top-line growth is going to create.

signals.speaker: Joaquin Duato
signals.sentence: You will hear more about that in our enterprise investor review later in the year.
